notification sound.note: Existing: 着信の通知音 for 'Notification sound for incoming calls'.

share extension.note: No existing translation in the repo. 共有機能拡張 follows Apple's Japanese terminology for Share Extension; the user-facing share sheet action itself is simply 共有.

bottom sheet.note: No existing translation; standard katakana loanword. Rarely user-visible.

swipe.note: Existing: 左にスワイプする.

toast.note: No existing translation; mostly internal terminology. Prefer describing the message itself (通知, メッセージ) in user-facing text.

screen lock.note: Existing repo strings use スクリーンロック; OS settings themselves say 画面ロック — keep スクリーンロック for consistency with existing translations.

jailbroken.note: Existing: 'JailbreakまたはRoot化されたデバイス' — Jailbreak kept in Latin script, rooted = Root化された.

deep link.note: No existing translation; standard katakana loanword.

skin tone.note: Existing: デフォルトの肌色 for 'Default Skin Tone'; individual emoji tone names are left in English.

server connection.note: Existing UI: サーバーを追加 (Add a server), サーバー切替 (Switch server), サーバーを編集する (Edit server).
